source_refs.note: Book p. 61-64: 2.13 Error in Differential Approximations, error / relative error / percentage error, Examples 25-29

blocks.text: Bachon, pichle sabaq mein humne dekha ke \(dy\) asal tabdeeli \(\Delta y\) ka andaza deta hai. Lekin har andaze ke saath ek sawal hota hai: andaza kitna ghalat hai? Aaj hum yahi napna seekhenge, aur phir dekhenge ke napne (measurement) ki chhoti si ghalti kisi calculated cheez, jaise volume ya area, mein kitni ghalti paida karti hai. Physics practicals mein yeh bohat kaam aata hai.
Maan lein \(f\) point \(x\) par differentiable function hai, aur \(x\) mein chhoti si tabdeeli \(\Delta x\) hoti hai. Agar:

items: \(\Delta y\) \(y\) mein asal (actual) tabdeeli ho, jo \(\Delta y = f(x + \Delta x) - f(x)\) se milti hai
\(dy\) differentials se mili takreebi (approximate) tabdeeli ho, jo \(dy = f'(x)\,dx\) se milti hai, jahan \(dx = \Delta x\)

blocks.text: To:
Error in Δy

blocks.text_alt: Error equals delta y minus d y

blocks.text: Relative error in Δy

blocks.latex: \text{Relative Error} = \dfrac{\Delta y - dy}{\Delta y} = \dfrac{\text{Error}}{\text{Original Value}},\ \Delta y \ne 0
blocks.text_alt: Relative error equals (delta y minus d y) over delta y, which is error over original value, when delta y is not zero

blocks.text: Percentage error Δy

blocks.text_alt: Percentage error equals the absolute value of (delta y minus d y) over delta y, times 100, when delta y is not zero

blocks.text: yani Percentage Error \(= \left|\frac{\text{Error}}{\text{Original value}}\right| \times 100\), jab \(\Delta y \ne 0\). \(\Delta y \ne 0\) ki shart is liye hai ke zero se divide nahi ho sakta.

Error batata hai ke aasaan andaza \(dy\) asal tabdeeli \(\Delta y\) se kitna door hai.
Relative error (nisbati ghalti) ghalti ko asal tabdeeli ke size se compare karti hai. Misaal: 1 rupay ki ghalti 1000 rupay ke bill mein maamooli hai, lekin 2 rupay ki toffee mein bohat bari. Isi tarah 0.03 ki ghalti \(\Delta y = 100\) ke saath chhoti hai, magar \(\Delta y = 0.3\) ke saath bari.
Percentage error wahi relative error hai, sau (100) ke hisaab se likha hua, aur hamesha positive (absolute value ki wajah se).
blocks.title: Teaching note

blocks.text: Ab examples dekhte hain. Example 25 mein hum \(dy\) aur \(\Delta y\) dono nikal kar un ka muqabla karenge.

blocks.title: Example 25
blocks.problem: Find \(dy\) and \(\Delta y\) for the function \(f(x) = x^{3}\) when \(x = 1\) and \(dx = 0.1\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = x^{3}\), \(x = 1\), \(dx = \Delta x = 0.1\).
Maloom karna: differential \(dy\) aur asal tabdeeli \(\Delta y\).
Tareeqa: \(dy = f'(x)\,dx\) (tangent line wali tabdeeli) aur \(\Delta y = f(x + \Delta x) - f(x)\) (asal tabdeeli). Dono nikal kar muqabla karenge.

Qadam 1: Derivative
\[f(x) = x^{3} \quad \text{...(1)}\]
\[f'(x) = 3x^{2}\]
Kyun: power rule: power 3 aage aayi aur ek kam ho kar 2 reh gayi.

Qadam 2: \(dy\) nikalein
\[dy = f'(x)\,dx = 3x^{2}\,dx\]
\[dy = 3(1)^{2}(0.1) = 0.3\]
Kyun: \(dy\) ke formula mein \(x = 1\) aur \(dx = 0.1\) rakh diye. Yeh tangent line ka uthna hai.

Qadam 3: \(\Delta y\) nikalein
\[\Delta y = f(x + \Delta x) - f(x)\]
\[= f(1 + 0.1) - f(1)\]
\[= f(1.1) - f(1)\]
\[= (1.1)^{3} - (1)^{3}\]
\[= 1.331 - 1 = 0.331\]
Kyun: equation (1) se \(f(x) = x^{3}\). Asal tabdeeli hamesha nayi value minus purani value hoti hai, aur yahan \(\Delta x = dx = 0.1\).
Dhyan dein: \((1.1)^{3} = 1.1 \times 1.1 \times 1.1 = 1.21 \times 1.1 = 1.331\); jaldi mein \(1.33\) ya \(1.21\) likh dena aam ghalti hai.

Tasdeeq (oopar wali definitions se ghalti):
\[\text{Error} = \Delta y - dy = 0.331 - 0.3 = 0.031\]
\[\left|\dfrac{0.031}{0.331}\right| \times 100 \approx 9.37\%\]
\(dy\) asal tabdeeli \(\Delta y\) ke qareeb hai. Jo 0.031 ka farq hai woh is liye hai ke curve \(x^{3}\) upar mud rahi hai aur tangent line woh mor nahi pakarti.

blocks.text: Example 25 se kya seekha? \(dy = 0.3\) nikalne ke liye sirf ek multiplication chahiye tha, jab ke \(\Delta y = 0.331\) ke liye \((1.1)^{3}\) ka poora hisaab. Dono mein sirf 0.031 ka farq hai. Yahi differentials ki taaqat hai: thori si accuracy de kar bohat sa hisaab bacha lete hain. Aur agar \(dx\) aur chhota hota, maslan 0.01, to farq aur bhi bohat kam ho jata.
Example 26 aur 27 mein hum differentials ko andaza lagane ke liye use karenge. Tareeqa wahi hai: qareeb ki aasaan value \(f(x)\), jama chhota sa correction \(dy\).

blocks.title: Example 26
steps:
Diya gaya: number \(\sqrt{24}\).
Maloom karna: calculator ke baghair is ki takreebi value.
Tareeqa: \(f(x + \Delta x) \approx f(x) + dy\), jahan \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\). Sab se qareebi perfect square 25 se shuru karenge, kyun ke \(\sqrt{25} = 5\) bilkul exact hai.

Qadam 1: Function chunein aur differentiate karein
\[f(x) = \sqrt{x} \quad \text{...(1)}\]
\[f'(x) = \tfrac{1}{2}x^{-1/2} = \dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{x}} \quad \text{...(2)}\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{x} = x^{1/2}\), aur power rule se power \(\frac{1}{2}\) aage aayi, ek kam ho kar \(-\frac{1}{2}\) bani.

Qadam 2: \(x\) aur \(\Delta x\) chunein
24 ke sab se qareeb perfect square 25 hai, is liye \(x = 25\).
Humein \(\sqrt{24}\) chahiye, to \(x + \Delta x = 24\) aur \(x = 25\):
\[25 + \Delta x = 24 \Rightarrow \Delta x = -1\]
Differential approximation mein \(dx = \Delta x\), is liye \(dx = -1\).
Kyun: hum 25 se neeche 24 ki taraf ja rahe hain, is liye qadam negative hai.
Dhyan dein: kitab yahan \(24 + \Delta x = 25\) chhaapti hai; sahi \(25 + \Delta x = 24\) hai (neeche Kitab ki ghalti dekhiye). \(\Delta x = -1\) phir bhi sahi hai.

Qadam 3: \(dy\) nikalein
\[dy = f'(x)\,dx = \dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}\,dx\]
\[dy = \dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{25}}(-1)\]
\[= -\dfrac{1}{10} = -0.1\]
Kyun: equation (2) mein \(x = 25\) aur \(dx = -1\) rakha. \(dy\) negative aaya, matlab value 5 se thori kam hogi, jo samajh mein aata hai.

Qadam 4: \(f(x + \Delta x) \approx f(x) + dy\) lagayein
\[f(25 - 1) \approx f(25) + (-0.1)\]
\[f(24) \approx f(25) - 0.1\]
Equation (1) se:
\[\sqrt{24} \approx \sqrt{25} - 0.1 = 5 - 0.1 = 4.9\]
Kyun: maloom value \(f(25) = 5\) jama chhota sa correction \(dy\). Yeh andaza hai, is liye \(\approx\) likha.

Tasdeeq:
\[4.9^{2} = 24.01\]
Yeh 24 ke bohat qareeb hai. Calculator: \(\sqrt{24} = 4.89898\), yani ghalti sirf takreeban \(0.001\).

blocks.text: Example 26 mein ghaur kijiye ke \(dx\) negative tha, is liye \(dy\) bhi negative aaya aur jawab 5 se kam nikla. Yeh common sense se bhi theek hai: \(\sqrt{24}\) zaroor \(\sqrt{25} = 5\) se thora kam hoga. Har sawal ke baad aise ek second ke liye soch lijiye ke jawab samajh mein aata hai ya nahi; is se bohat si ghaltiyan pakri jati hain.

Example 26 mein kitab \(24 + \Delta x = 25 \Rightarrow \Delta x = -1\) chhaapti hai. \(x + \Delta x = 24\) aur \(x = 25\) se sahi equation \(25 + \Delta x = 24\) hai, jis se \(\Delta x = -1\) aata hai (chhapi hui equation se to \(+1\) aata). Humne upar sahi equation likhi hai.
Aakhri line mein kitab \(\sqrt{24} = \sqrt{25} - 0.1\) likhti hai; yeh andaza hai, is liye \(\sqrt{24} \approx 4.9\) likhna chahiye.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
Example 27
blocks.problem: Using differentials approximate the value of \(\cos 61^\circ 3\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\cos 61^\circ\) (kitab mein chhapa "3" faltu character hai; neeche Kitab ki ghalti dekhiye).
Maloom karna: \(\cos 61^\circ\) ki takreebi value.
Tareeqa: \(f(x + \Delta x) \approx f(x) + dy\), jahan \(f(x) = \cos x\). \(60^\circ\) se shuru karenge kyun ke us ka cosine aur sine dono zubani maloom hain. \(dx\) radians mein lena zaroori hai.

Qadam 1: Function aur derivative
\[f(x) = \cos x \quad \text{...(1)}\]
\[f'(x) = -\sin x \quad \text{...(2)}\]
Kyun: cosine ka standard derivative; minus sign zaroor saath rakhein.

Qadam 2: \(x\) aur \(\Delta x\) chunein
\(x = 60^\circ\) chuna kyun ke \(\cos 60^\circ\) nikalna aasaan hai.
\[x + \Delta x = 61^\circ,\ x = 60^\circ\]
\[60^\circ + \Delta x = 61^\circ \Rightarrow \Delta x = 1^\circ\]
\[dx = 1^\circ = \dfrac{\pi}{180} \text{ radian}\]
Kyun: differential approximation mein \(dx = \Delta x\), aur \(\cos x\) ka derivative formula sirf radians mein sahi hai.
Dhyan dein: \(dx = 1\) rakh dena (degree hi) sab se bari ghalti hai; jawab bilkul ghalat aa jata hai.

Qadam 3: \(dy\) nikalein
\[dy = f'(x)\,dx = -\sin x\,dx\]
\[dy = -\sin 60^\circ\left(\dfrac{\pi}{180}\right)\]
\[= -\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \times \dfrac{\pi}{180}\]
\[= -0.0151\]
Kyun: (2) mein \(x = 60^\circ\) aur \(dx = \frac{\pi}{180}\) rakha. \(\sin 60^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \approx 0.866\) aur \(\frac{\pi}{180} \approx 0.017453\); in ka product takreeban 0.0151.

Qadam 4: \(f(x + \Delta x) \approx f(x) + dy\) lagayein
\[f(61^\circ) \approx f(60^\circ) + (-0.0151)\]
Equation (1) se:
\[\cos 61^\circ \approx \cos 60^\circ - 0.0151\]
\[= 0.5 - 0.0151 = 0.4849\]
Kyun: \(\cos 60^\circ = 0.5\) bilkul exact. \(dy\) negative hai kyun ke \(0^\circ\) se \(90^\circ\) tak cosine ghatta hai; angle barha to value kam hui.

Tasdeeq:
Calculator: \(\cos 61^\circ = 0.48481\). Hamara andaza \(0.4849\) is se \(0.0001\) se bhi kam farq rakhta hai.

blocks.text: Example 27 ke sawal mein kitab "approximate the value of \(\cos 61^\circ 3\)" chhaapti hai. Yeh "3" faltu chhap gaya hai: hal \(\cos 61^\circ\) ka hi hai (\(\approx 0.4849\)). Aakhri line mein bhi takreebi value ke liye "\(=\)" likha hai jahan "\(\approx\)" hona chahiye.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text:
Example 28 aur 29 mein "error" ek doosre, practical matlab mein hai: kisi cheez ko napne mein ghalti (side ya radius mein, yani \(dx\) ya \(dr\)) us se calculate ki gayi cheez (volume, area) mein ghalti paida karti hai, jis ka andaza us ke differential (\(dV\), \(dA\)) se lagate hain.
Calculated quantity \(Q\) ka percentage error: \(\left|\frac{dQ}{Q}\right| \times 100\).
Shortcut: agar \(Q = kx^{n}\) ho to \(\frac{dQ}{Q} = n\frac{dx}{x}\), yani percentage error power \(n\) se multiply ho jata hai (cube ka volume: 3 guna; circle ka area: 2 guna; circumference: 1 guna). Exam mein yeh shortcut jawab check karne ke liye bohat kaam aata hai.
blocks.title: Teaching note

blocks.text: Ab ek practical situation: aap ne ek cube ki side scale se napi, lekin scale ya aankh ki wajah se thori ghalti ho sakti hai. Sawal yeh hai ke is ghalti ki wajah se volume kitna ghalat calculate hoga? Differentials is ka seedha jawab dete hain, aur dilchasp baat yeh ke volume ki ghalti side ki ghalti se kahin zyada hoti hai.

blocks.title: Example 28
blocks.problem:
The side of a cube is measured to be 25 cm, with a possible error of \(\pm 1\) cm.
(a) Use differentials to estimate the error in the calculated volume.
(b) Estimate the percentage errors in the side and volume.
steps:
Diya gaya: side \(x = 25\) cm, side mein ghalti \(dx = \Delta x = \pm 1\) cm.
Maloom karna: (a) volume mein ghalti \(dV\); (b) side aur volume mein percentage error.
Tareeqa: kisi calculated cheez ki ghalti us ke differential se nikalte hain: \(V = x^{3}\), to \(dV = 3x^{2}\,dx\). Napne (measurement) ki ghalti \(dx\) hai, aur us ka asar volume par \(dV\) hai.

(a) Qadam 1: \(V\) ka differential
\[V = x^{3}\]
\[dV = \dfrac{d}{dx}(x^{3})\,dx\]
\[= 3x^{2}\,dx \quad \text{...(1)}\]
Kyun: side mein chhoti si ghalti \(dx\) volume mein takreeban \(dV\) ki tabdeeli laati hai; yahi pichle sabaq ka \(\Delta y \approx dy\) hai.

Qadam 2: (1) mein \(x = 25\), \(dx = \pm 1\) rakhein
\[dV = 3(25)^{2}(\pm 1)\]
\[= \pm 1875 \text{ cm}^{3}\]
Yani volume ki andazan ghalti \(\pm 1875\) cm\(^{3}\) hai.
Kyun: \(25^{2} = 625\) aur \(3 \times 625 = 1875\). \(\pm\) is liye ke napne wala zyada bhi nap sakta hai aur kam bhi.

(b) Qadam 3: Side ka percentage error
\[\left|\dfrac{dx}{x}\right| \times 100 = \dfrac{1}{25} \times 100\]
\[= 4\% \quad \text{...(2)}\]
Kyun: percentage error = (ghalti / napi hui value) \(\times\) 100. Absolute value is liye ke percentage error positive likhte hain.

Qadam 4: Volume ka percentage error
\(V = x^{3}\) aur \(dV = 3x^{2}\,dx\), is liye:
\[\left|\dfrac{dV}{V}\right| \times 100 = \left|\dfrac{3x^{2}\,dx}{x^{3}}\right| \times 100\]
\[= 3 \times \left|\dfrac{dx}{x}\right| \times 100\]
Equation (2) se:
\[\left|\dfrac{dV}{V}\right| \times 100 = 3 \times 4\% = 12\%\]
Kyun: \(\frac{x^{2}}{x^{3}} = \frac{1}{x}\) cancel hua, to volume ka percentage error side ke percentage error ka 3 guna nikla. Power 3 thi, isi liye 3 guna.

Tasdeeq:
\[V = 25^{3} = 15625 \text{ cm}^{3}\]
\[\dfrac{1875}{15625} \times 100 = 12\%\]
Part (a) ki ghalti aur asal volume se bhi wahi 12% aaya.

blocks.text: Example 28 ka sabaq: side mein sirf 4% ghalti thi, magar volume mein 12% ho gayi. Is liye jab koi cheez power wale formula se calculate ho, to napne mein bohat ehtiyaat chahiye. Example 29 mein yahi baat circle ke liye dekhte hain, lekin is dafa radius ki value di hi nahi gayi, sirf percentage error diya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Example 29
blocks.problem:
The radius \(r\) of a circle is measured with an error of at most 2%. What is the maximum corresponding percentage error in computing the circle's
(a) circumference? (b) area?
steps:
Diya gaya: radius ka percentage error \(\left|\frac{dr}{r}\right| \times 100 = 2\%\).
Maloom karna: (a) \(C = 2\pi r\) aur (b) \(A = \pi r^{2}\) ka percentage error.
Tareeqa: har formula ka differential nikalein, us ko formula se hi divide karein, aur diya hua 2% rakh dein. Radius ki asal value ki zaroorat hi nahi parti.

Qadam 1: Di hui ghalti
\(r\) radius hai, aur radius napne ka percentage error hai
\[\left|\dfrac{dr}{r}\right| \times 100 = 2\% \quad \text{...(1)}\]
Kyun: "at most 2%" ka matlab hai sab se zyada 2%; isi se maximum error milega.

(a) Qadam 2: Circumference ka differential
\[C = 2\pi r\]
\[dC = \dfrac{d}{dr}(2\pi r)\,dr = 2\pi\,dr \quad \text{...(2)}\]
Kyun: \(2\pi\) constant hai, is liye \(2\pi r\) ka derivative sirf \(2\pi\).

Qadam 3: Circumference ka percentage error
\[\left|\dfrac{dC}{C}\right| \times 100 = \left|\dfrac{2\pi\,dr}{2\pi r}\right| \times 100\]
\[= \left|\dfrac{dr}{r}\right| \times 100\]
Equation (1) se:
\[\left|\dfrac{dC}{C}\right| \times 100 = 2\%\]
Kyun: \(2\pi\) cancel ho gaya. \(C\) seedha \(r\) ke proportional hai (power 1), is liye us ka percentage error bhi wahi 2%.

(b) Qadam 4: Area ka differential
\[A = \pi r^{2}\]
\[dA = \dfrac{d}{dr}(\pi r^{2})\,dr = 2\pi r\,dr\]
Kyun: power rule; \(\pi\) constant hai.

Qadam 5: Area ka percentage error
\[\left|\dfrac{dA}{A}\right| \times 100 = \left|\dfrac{2\pi r\,dr}{\pi r^{2}}\right| \times 100\]
\[= 2 \times \left|\dfrac{dr}{r}\right| \times 100\]
Equation (1) se:
\[\left|\dfrac{dA}{A}\right| \times 100 = 2 \times 2\% = 4\%\]
Kyun: \(\frac{r}{r^{2}} = \frac{1}{r}\). Power 2 thi, is liye percentage error do guna ho gaya.

Tasdeeq numbers se (koi bhi radius chalega), maslan \(r = 10\), \(dr = 0.2\) (yani 2%):
\[dA = 2\pi(10)(0.2) = 4\pi,\ A = 100\pi\]
\[\dfrac{4\pi}{100\pi} \times 100 = 4\%\]
Bilkul wahi jawab.

blocks.text: Example 29 mein radius ki value ke baghair jawab aa gaya, kyun ke \(\frac{dC}{C}\) aur \(\frac{dA}{A}\) mein \(r\) cancel ho jata hai. Jab bhi sawal sirf percentage error de aur percentage error hi maange, to yahi tareeqa lagaiye: differential ko asal formula se divide karein aur dekhiye ke kya cancel hota hai.

Sphere ka volume \(V = \frac{4}{3}\pi r^{3}\) hai. Agar radius mein 1% ghalti ho to volume mein kitni hogi?
(Jawab: power 3 hai, to \(3 \times 1\% = 3\%\).)
blocks.title: Khud sochiye

blocks.text:
Square ki side 10 cm napi gayi, ghalti \(\pm 0.1\) cm. Area \(A = x^{2}\), \(dA = 2x\,dx = 2(10)(\pm 0.1) = \pm 2\) cm\(^{2}\).
Percentage error: side ka \(\frac{0.1}{10} \times 100 = 1\%\), area ka \(\frac{2}{100} \times 100 = 2\%\), yani do guna, jaisa shortcut kehta hai.
blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal

blocks.text:
1. Error \(= \Delta y - dy\); relative error \(= \frac{\Delta y - dy}{\Delta y}\); percentage error \(= \left|\frac{\Delta y - dy}{\Delta y}\right| \times 100\).
2. Value ka andaza: \(f(x + \Delta x) \approx f(x) + f'(x)\,dx\), qareeb ki aasaan value se shuru karein.
3. Angles mein \(dx\) radians mein: \(1^\circ = \frac{\pi}{180}\).
4. Napne ki ghalti: \(dQ = Q'(x)\,dx\); percentage error \(\left|\frac{dQ}{Q}\right| \times 100\).
5. \(Q = kx^{n}\) ho to \(Q\) ka percentage error \(= n \times\) \(x\) ka percentage error.
blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein

blocks.text:
1. \(1^\circ\) ke liye \(dx = 1\) rakh dena; sahi \(\frac{\pi}{180}\) hai.
2. \(\Delta x\) ka sign ghalat: 25 se neeche 24 par jana \(\Delta x = -1\) hai.
3. Takreebi value ke liye \(=\) likhna.
4. Absolute value bhool kar negative percentage error likh dena.
5. Percentage errors ko jama kar dena, jab ke power se multiply karna hai.
